title: Tunisian Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious stir fry dish inspired by Tunisian cuisine, made with a variety of vegetables and earthy spices.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the earthy mushrooms and crisp carrots, and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the pea shoots and Tunisian spice blend, and stir-fry for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional pea shoots if desired.
